Minors researched 2026-11-06 (Indiana DOL, https://www.in.gov/dol/youth-employment/youth-employment-home/): since Jan. 1, 2025 Indiana mirrors federal limits for 14-15 (federal.json; 9 p.m. allowed June 1-Labor Day), and 'There are no hour restrictions for 16- and 17-year-olds.' No extra state rules encoded.
Minors: Indiana no longer requires breaks for minors; employers with 5+ minors must register them in the Youth Employment System (IC 22-2-18.1).
